text: Kasmanda Palace is an authentic 180-year-old royal retreat just a 3-minute walk from Mall Road. Spacious garden lawns with majestic Doon valley panorama.
Heritage rooms with high ceilings and antique furniture. Breakfast buffet had good North Indian varieties, though service was slightly slow during morning rush.
Prime location above Mall Road gives the perfect balance of easy town access without noise. Garden seating for evening tea is peaceful.
Old heritage charm but bathroom geyser took 20 minutes to heat up water in rainy August. Front desk was cooperative and sent maintenance quickly.
Staff bhaiya bohot courteous aur helpful the. Parking space inside the property compound is a huge relief on Mussoorie Mall Road.
Magnificent colonial decor with royal trophies and photographs. Dinner at the Magnolia restaurant was delicious and well prepared.
Chilly mountain air in November, room heater was provided on request and kept room comfortable.
Walking distance to Picture Palace and Mall Road shopping. Clean linen and spotless bathrooms. Excellent heritage value for money.
Winter chill was intense but electric blankets kept us warm. Breakfast spread with fresh hot parathas was delightful.
Hospitality fit for royalty. Welcomed with hot ginger tea and swift check-in. The best heritage base on the main ridge.
